block-guide:
CORE/PAGE-LIST A list of the site's pages built by WordPress each time the page is shown: every published page, child pages nested under their parent, ordered by page order, then title. Nothing in it is chosen by hand. Chosen links: core/navigation with navigation-link blocks, or core/list.
MARKUP (checked in the editor; comment only, no HTML) <!-- wp:page-list /--> <!-- wp:page-list {"parentPageID":<pageId>} /-->
OPTIONS parentPageID: only the children of that page (the page itself is not listed). If it has no published children, the block shows nothing. No setting excludes pages, limits depth or changes the order: every published page appears, including pages added later and test pages. Drafts and private pages do not. Colours, typography, border and spacing follow the general rules (in the comment only). Inside core/navigation it draws its pages as menu items and submenus.
ON THE PAGE <ul class="wp-block-page-list"> with <li class="wp-block-pages-list__item"> and <a class="wp-block-pages-list__item__link">; the current page's item gets current-menu-item.
CHECK Open the page: the list matches the published pages you expect.
